tools.name: designesy_catalog
tools.description: Get the designesy.org package catalog — 12 published packages (contracts, kits, labs, reviews) with versions, URLs, and statuses. Read-only. Returns the full catalog from /open.json including standing rules, machine exports, and identity.

tools.name: designesy_contract
tools.description: Get the designesy.org design-system contract (v0.3.0) — tokens, motion, acoustic, takt, cadence, typography, components, verification, open tensions. Read-only. Returns the full contract from /contracts/design-system.json, or a filtered section if "section" is provided. Available sections: colors, m

tools.name: designesy_design_review
tools.description: Get the Designesy Design Review kit — 8 review dimensions (Purpose, Clarity, Context, Inclusion, System coherence, Durability, Delight, Responsibility), agent prompt, output format, and verification checklist. Read-only: returns the kit framework for the calling agent to execute. Optionally provide

tools.name: designesy_skill_md
tools.description: Get the designesy.org SKILL.md — the agent-skill-format export of the design-system contract with behavioral rules, tokens, anti-patterns, and verification. Read-only. Returns markdown content from /contracts/skill.

tools.name: designesy_agent_json
tools.description: Get the designesy.org agent discovery document (/.well-known/agent.json) — identity, authority, ingest protocol, packages, machine exports, permission policy, and cite templates. Read-only.

tools.name: designesy_llms_txt
tools.description: Get the designesy.org /llms.txt — short agent-facing brief with canonical reference, topics, ingest steps, package list, and contact. Read-only. Returns text/plain content.

tools.name: designesy_llms_full_txt
tools.description: Get the designesy.org /llms-full.txt — full agent-facing brief with ingest protocol, discovery endpoints, all packages, standing rules, anti-patterns, and the complete paste-ready agent prompt. Read-only. Returns text/plain content.

tools.name: designesy_score
tools.description: Run the designesy.org contract verification checklist against a live URL.
